# scira v0.3.0

SCIRA now audits whole hosts for runtime advisories, not just PyPI/npm
manifests. Six new built-in incident profiles plus MCP config scanning, all
with the same single-binary, deterministic-scan design.

## New incident profiles

Run any of them host-wide: `sudo scira scan <incident> --all-dirs`

- **`php`** — PHP "PHP2Shell" critical RCEs (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619,
  CVSS 9.2, unauthenticated, actively scanned in the wild). Detects host
  binaries, dpkg packages, running containers, and image metadata against the
  8.2.35 / 8.3.36 / 8.4.27 / 8.5.12 fixes; EOL lines flagged.
- **`node`** — Node.js October 2026 security releases (Brotli decoder RCE
  CVE-2026-111497, TLS/DNS bypasses, eMudhra CA refresh). Covers PATH installs,
  per-user nvm/volta/.local trees, dpkg, containers, image metadata.
- **`brotli`** — Google Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write (CVE-2026-111497,
  1.0.3–1.2.0, fixed 1.0.10/1.1.1/1.2.1) across dpkg libbrotli, the brotli CLI,
  Python Brotli/brotlicffi bindings, and containers.
- **`emudhra`** — eMudhra emSign intermediate CA compromise: finds trust stores
  (host + containers) that still ship the distrusted `emSign ECC Root CA - G3`
  root or reference the eight revoked G3 intermediates.
- **`playwright`** — Playwright ecosystem: core < 1.56.0 (CVE-2025-59288
  installer), 1.64.x bundled Firefox 157.0 (CVE-2026-106016),
  `@playwright/mcp` < 0.0.40 (CVE-2025-9611 DNS rebinding), and cached browser
  builds in every user's `~/.cache/ms-playwright` (incl. the actively exploited
  Chromium 145.0.7632.6 / CVE-2026-2441, both full and headless-shell layouts).
- **`nginx`** — NGINX2Root HTTP/2 RCEs (CVE-2026-123007 CVSS 9.2 with public
  PoC, CVE-2026-123633 CVSS 8.1 with proxied backends). Install discovery
  across PATH, standard prefixes, running processes, dpkg, containers, image
  metadata, and k8s ingress-nginx; config-level exposure analysis
  (`listen … http2` / `http2 on` + `proxy_pass` family) annotates each hit as
  EXPOSED or verify; `nginx -V` fork markers (Tengine/OpenResty) and missing
  `--with-http_v2_module` downgrade reachability.

## `--live` distro backport confirmation

`sudo scira scan nginx --all-dirs --live` asks OSV whether the installed
distro package already carries the backported fix (e.g. Ubuntu noble
1.24.0-2ubuntu7.20, USN-9159-1). Downgrades to *safe* only on positive
evidence — absence of tracker data never produces a safe verdict.

## MCP STDIO config scanning

`scira scan mcp-stdio` inventories MCP servers across local configs, compose
files, Dockerfiles, and the docker runtime, and flags high-risk execution
surfaces (shell-evaluated launches, unpinned package runners, sensitive
mounts, exposed ports).

## Everything else

- Existing `litellm` and `axios` incident flows unchanged.
- Reports remain structured JSON + text with meaningful exit codes
  (0 / 10 / 20); `scira explain` still works on saved JSON reports.
- Bundled advisory expertise and IOC tables live in
  `bundled/host-runtime-response/` for the LLM explainer.

## Install

Download the right binary from the release assets, rename it to `scira`,
make it executable (`sha256sums.txt` for verification). On macOS remove the
quarantine attribute if needed: `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine ./scira`.

```bash
curl -L -o scira https://github.com/makash/scira/releases/download/v0.3.0/scira-darwin-arm64   # macOS Apple Silicon
curl -L -o scira https://github.com/makash/scira/releases/download/v0.3.0/scira-darwin-amd64   # macOS Intel
curl -L -o scira https://github.com/makash/scira/releases/download/v0.3.0/scira-linux-amd64    # Linux x86_64
chmod +x scira
./scira scan nginx --all-dirs
```
